subject: Error in dimnames(x) <- dn when using DIF function

messages.author: 977a0c86ee1c91a0
messages.subject: Error in dimnames(x) <- dn when using DIF function
parts:
Hi, I just found a new problem that I didn´t have before. I just tried to run again a couple of DIF analyses that I made a few months ago, but now I cannot replicate it. 

When I try to use the DIF function for a multipleGroup object with 4 groups, I get this error:

Error in dimnames(x) <- dn :
  length of 'dimnames' [1] not equal to array extent

The strange part is that it used to work a few months ago. I don´t know if it is a bug on this package or if maybe another package is the one responsible.

What is most curious is that when I run this with just 2 groups it works, but in this version that has 4 groups it throughs this error

I am running R 4.2.1 and mirt 1.37.1

messages.subject: Re: Error in dimnames(x) <- dn when using DIF function
parts:
I emailed you individually, but I want to post the response here too: 

Sure, here is a quick example: 

library(mirt)

nitem = 4

n.g1 = 2000
n.g2 = 1000
n.g3 = 1000
n.g4 = 1000

groups = c(rep('g1', n.g1), rep('g2', n.g2), rep('g3', n.g3), rep('g4', n.g4))

a <- rep(1, nitem)
d1 <- d2 <- d3 <- d4 <- matrix(rnorm(nitem,0,.7),ncol=1)
d4[4, ] <- d1[4, ] + 1 # here is the DIF

item.type <- rep('dich', nitem)

# Generate data
dat1 <- simdata(a, d1, n.g1, item.type)
dat2 <- simdata(a, d2, n.g2, item.type)
dat3 <- simdata(a, d3, n.g3, item.type)
dat4 <- simdata(a, d4, n.g4, item.type)

dat <- rbind(dat1,dat2,dat3,dat4)



test.model <- mirt(dat,1,'Rasch')

anchor.set <- colnames(dat)[1:2]
 
res.model <- multipleGroup(dat, 1,
                           group = groups,
                           itemtype = "Rasch",
                           invariance = c("free_var", "free_mean", anchor.set),
                           SE = T)



# Does not work
DIF(res.model, c('d'), Wald = F, items2test = 4)

# Works
DIF(res.model, c('d'), Wald = T, items2test = 4)

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Error in dimnames(x) <- dn when using DIF function
parts:
Thanks, all variants in DIF with more than two groups should be patched now on the dev. When 3 or more groups are specified joint tests for DIF are performed, however in situations where post-hoc DIF testing is to be investigated there is now a groups2test input to isolate the individual grouping variable combinations (e.g., groups2test = c('g1', 'g2')). Thanks for bringing this to my attention. 

Phil
